title: Moulded cup, all four sides sloped (what a student would want)
script:
const b = box(60, 40, 25)
draft(b.face('right'), 5, { from: 'bottom' })
draft(b.face('left'), 5, { from: 'bottom' })
draft(b.face('front'), 5, { from: 'bottom' })
draft(b.face('back'), 5, { from: 'bottom' })
hollow(b, { wall: 2, open: 'top' })

title: Common mistakes on one part: wall too thick, round too big, hole wider than the part
script:
const b = box(40, 30, 10)
round(b.edge('top', 'right'), 12)
hole(b, { across: 35 })
hollow(b, { wall: 6, open: 'top' })
